description.html: The pirate ship is an aquarium decoration that catches the eye immediately. It has several masts with torn, overgrown sails, a skull-and-crossbones flag on top and a hull with a row of openings, so it looks like a wreck that has lain on the seabed for years. The details are rich, so the ship looks best as the centerpiece of the setup.

The openings in the hull let fish enter the ship and use it as a hiding place, which is especially useful for shyer species that need places to retreat. It is ideal for kids' aquariums and for anyone who wants a themed aquarium with nautical motifs. Combine it with the pirate skull and anchor for the full pirate look.

Before placing it, rinse the ship in lukewarm water, without detergents. Because of its height, place it in the back or middle of the aquarium, firmly on sand or gravel, so it does not block the view of the fish or the water flow from the filter. Clean the thin sails and masts carefully with a soft brush so you do not damage them.
